comments.author: Beomi
comments.body:
You can buy this item once whenever you defeat "Alice & Therese" at Coliseum.
Cost: Roman Coin 5,000

It is used for hiring Alice/Therese butler in your quarters when "Extra Chapter Polaris" comes on Maris.
(Next Chapter of "Silk Road")

It would be better to discover The Sahara / Sylphs in advance.

comments.author: Beomi
comments.body: Material for doing Request for a Strange Delivery

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Can also be used to craft Ancient Aether Charm (Med) - see its page for details.
